name: reconcileai
description: ReconcileAI — the canonical domain model, the design record, and the mechanical checkers. There is no application here yet; see docs/build/phase-one-plan.md.

scripts.synth:infra: node infra/ensure-deps.mjs && npm --prefix infra run synth
scripts.dev:plane: RECONCILE_DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 RECONCILE_DB_PORT=5432 RECONCILE_DB_NAME=reconcile_browser RECONCILE_APP_PASSWORD=dataplane_local_app_pw RECONCILE_HTTP_HOST=127.0.0.1 RECONCILE_HTTP_PORT=8080 RECONCILE_LOCAL_TEST_AUTH=1 node server/data-plane/main.ts
scripts.dev:plane:migrate: RECONCILE_DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 RECONCILE_DB_PORT=5432 RECONCILE_DB_NAME=reconcile_browser RECONCILE_APP_PASSWORD=dataplane_local_app_pw RECONCILE_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD=dataplane_local_mig_pw RECONCILE_DEV_SEED=1 node server/data-plane/migrate-main.ts
scripts.build:frontend: vite build -c frontend/vite.config.ts && vite build -c frontend/vite.config.ts --ssr src/prerender.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node frontend/dist-ssr/prerender.js && npm run build:site
scripts.build:site: vite build -c frontend/site/vite.config.ts && vite build -c frontend/site/vite.config.ts --ssr src/prerender.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node frontend/site/dist-ssr/prerender.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:infra && npm run synth:infra && npm run check:counts && npm run check:citations && npm run check:wire && npm run check:packs && npm run check:c4 && npm run check:g-numbers && npm run check:migrations && npm run check:absent-rows && npm run check:annotations && npm run check:clocks && npm run check:derivations && npm run build:frontend && npm test
